stem:
Sahil studies a plant cell under a microscope. He wants to explain what gives the plant cell its firmness and rigidity.

Which explanation is correct?

options.text: The cell membrane gives the plant cell its firmness and rigidity.
The cell wall gives the plant cell its firmness and rigidity.
Every plastid in the plant cell gives it its firmness and rigidity.
The plant cell is firm because it looks green under the microscope.

teacher.key_rationale: In plant cells the cell wall provides firmness and rigidity. The membrane is the wrong structure; plastids are not the firmness structures; green appearance alone does not explain firmness.

mx_swap.reason: Chlorophyll-without-photosynthesis CWO is a second idea; stem holds the firmness hinge only.
Photosynthesis-produces-chlorophyll CWO is a second idea; stem holds the firmness hinge only.
